name: Jessica A.
headline: - Consulting Practice Director - NetSuite Services Industry Vertical
about:
Customer-centric leader bringing 19 years of innovation and exceptional performance. Proven track record of driving exceptional service delivery by building and scaling diverse remote teams in high-growth environments. Diverse experience developing and service strategies, offerings, and methodologies. Driven to solve complex business problems by cultivating partnerships with internal and customer stakeholders at all levels of the business. Passion for continuous improvement, transparency, and cultivating a growth mindset; creative and capable in guiding customers and teams through change and ambiguity.
… more

experiences.description:
•	Lead a geographically distributed, multi-national team of managers, project managers, and solution architects.
•	Manage a portfolio of projects for customers representing ~11 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR).
•	Build and maintain strong relationships with customers' executive leadership, partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure high customer satisfaction and value recognition, leading to successful implementations, references, contract renewals and revenue growth opportunities.
•	Enable project teams to achieve the highest possible customer satisfaction while meeting our goals for ARR, hours delivered, book to bill ratio, forecast accuracy, and project profitability.
•	Collaborate closely with Direct Sales, Account Management, Customer Support, Product and to drive continuous strategic process improvement throughout the customer journey. 
•	Pursue and close profitable new services business and identify opportunities within existing   customers in conjunction with Sales and Account Management.
•	Develop new leaders, including in Manila and India GDC (Global Delivery Center). 
•	OCI Generative AI Professional Certification in progress. 

Key Accomplishments FY25:
•	Portfolio Net Promoter Score (NPS) 86 (99% positive)
•	96% forecast accuracy
•	105% average target attainment for hours delivered and profitability targets
•	Projects completed on average within 2% of budget

•	Managed a geographically distributed, multi-national team of consultants and project managers.
•	Oversaw a portfolio of ~60 projects ranging in size from large-scale implementations for new customers to optimization projects for existing customers.
•	Enabled my direct team as well as project teams to deliver on quarterly targets for customer satisfaction (NPS) and quarterly billable hours/utilization.
•	Acted as PMO Vertical Advocate - collaborated closely with PMO to improve PM training, methodology, and project delivery.
•	Contributed to process optimization, including new implementation methodology (SuiteSuccess) and Promotion Review Board process.

- Managed geographically distributed team of project managers, consultants and analysts, ensuring we achieve utilization and customer satisfaction targets
- Oversaw a portfolio of implementation and optimization projects
- Consistently delivered on quarterly billable hours targets  
- Supported sales team in promoting the value of Customer Success & Services
- Worked closely with PMO to oversee development of PM training, collateral and reusable work product

- Simultaneously managed 10 -25 projects of various sizes and complexities
- Managed ERP and PSA implementations delivered according the NetSuite ONE methodology
- Worked closely with client executives, project managers and stakeholders to ensure continuous alignment and effective collaboration throughout the project
- Managed business requirements mapping process and execution of deliverables
- Led project teams ranging in size from 2-10 resources
- Organized cross-functional teams and 3rd parties to complete project goals
- Identified and mitigated risks; aggressively controlled timeline, budget and scope
- Scoped projects and change orders; wrote Statements of Work
- Attended regular PMO meetings and helped develop templates and process improvements

- Led requirements analysis workshops with clients to define business process and functional requirements
- Designed, documented, and configured solutions to optimize complex, organization-specific business processes
- Achieved a 95% client satisfaction rating as measured by post-implementation surveys
- Mentored new consultants

Scored in 99 percentile on Law School Admissions Test (LSAT) to qualify for position

Instruction of law school bound students nationally for success on the LSAT both in classes and through private tutoring (classes up 120) 

Research and development of teaching techniques and materials
